response.text:
Hello! 😊 I am your WuWa Config Patcher Assistant.

I can guide you through every feature of the patcher:
• 1-Click Preset Patching: Deploy curated stable, performance, or extreme visuals configs.
• Live INI Editor: Edit Engine.ini and DeviceProfiles.ini with Smart, Text, and One-Line modes.
• Section Guards & Auto-Fix: Correct misplaced CVars and strip invalid prefixes instantly.

• Diagnostics & Tools: CVar Analyzer, AlteriaX CVar Bank, Duplicate Flagger, Forbidden Stripper, and Log Decryptor.

WuWa Config Patcher (io.github.arglax.configpatcher — Version v1.5.1, versionCode = 31) is a free, open-source elevated Android utility built by developer Arglax.

Architecture & Tech Stack:
• Language & UI: Kotlin 2.4.10, Jetpack Compose with Material 3 design system.
• Networking & Serialization: OkHttp 4, Retrofit 2 with KotlinX Serialization.
• Storage & Elevation: AndroidX DocumentFile (SAF), Rikka Shizuku API (target SDK 36), topjohnwu libsu Core 6.0.0, and Firebase BoM 34.16.0.
• OS Target: compileSdk 37, targetSdk 36, minSdk 30 (Android 11 minimum, Android 13+ recommended).

Update Checking:
The app verifies releases against app-version.txt hosted on the GitHub repository via UpdateChecker.kt. You can trigger manual checks under Settings > Application Info.

Supported Package Variants:
• Global (com.kurogame.wutheringwaves.global)
• Bilibili, Kuro (Mainland), TW, JP, and KR variants.

WuWa Config Patcher is structured around a single-activity layout with 5 bottom navigation tabs:

1. Config (ConfigScreen): Select repositories (Default GitHub, Custom HTTP ZIP, or Local SAF), browse categorized presets, and run 1-Click Patch or per-file selective patching.
2. Editor (EditorScreen): Live on-device INI editor supporting Smart, Raw Text, and One-Line dropdown editing, alongside the Misc Patch subtab (C# flag and skip splash).
3. Utilities (UtilitiesScreen): Split into Common (Decrypted Log Explorer, Device Info, Vanilla Revert, Share Patch) and Advanced (CVar Analyzer, 1000+ CVar Bank, Duplicate Flagger, Forbidden Stripper, Main Storage).
4. Settings (SettingsScreen): Configure tooltips, haptics, and DND; check update status; test elevation backends; and access guarded Danger Zone recovery tools.
5. Support (SupportScreen): Interactive Bug Report generator, Discord and GitHub links, GCash/InstaPay donation modal, and WuWaLab showcase.

1-Click Preset Patching Workflow (Tab 1: ConfigScreen):

1. Choose Repository: Select Arglax (Default) (queries GitHub API via GitHubApi.kt for custom-metadata.txt and preset ZIPs), Custom Online Repository (direct HTTP/HTTPS ZIP archive URL), or Local Repository (picked via Android SAF OpenDocumentTree()).
2. Sync & Extract: Tap Sync Files & Refresh (or pull down to refresh). ZipExtractor.kt extracts archives into context.cacheDir/repo_cache/, while ConfigScanner.kt and ConfigNode.kt walk top-down through subfolders to index valid INI files.
3. Select Categorized Preset: Browse categories assigned by PresetCategorization.kt (STABLE, PERFORMANCE, HIGH_VISUAL, COMMUNITY, OTHER).
4. Execute Patch: Tap 1-Click Patch. MainStorageManager.kt automatically generates a timestamped snapshot in app_main_storage/backups/ before injecting files via elevated Shizuku/Root IPC.

• Selective File Patching: Tap the Gear Icon (⚙️) beside 1-Click Patch to open AdvancedPatchDialog.kt and toggle individual INI files.
• Quick Launch: Tap Launch Game to auto-detect your installed package variant and launch Wuthering Waves.

Live Config Editor (Tab 2: EditorScreen):
Directly reads and writes on-device game configs using ShizukuManager.readLogFile() with in-memory caching for zero-millisecond tab switching. Use the top dropdown to select Engine.ini, DeviceProfiles.ini, Scalability.ini, or GameUserSettings.ini.

• Smart Mode: Visual section cards with granular controls. Includes Sort A-Z (sortSmartSectionsAlphabetically()), Auto-Fix Sections, numeric steppers (with negative number handling), and multi-select bulk deletion.
• Text Mode: Full syntax-highlighted editor with line numbers, Isolation Search Mode, find/replace ("Replace Next" / "Replace All"), and font scaling (8sp–24sp). Uses safeMapping to clamp offsets and defensive \r\n line-ending normalization to prevent IllegalStateException crashes when pasting.
• One-Line Mode: Fast dropdown selector with a real-time buffer preview card before saving, complete with live Section Guard validation notes.

title: Engine CVar Section Guards
keywords: cvars prefix error in engine ini

response.text:
Engine CVar Section Guards (CVarSectionGuard.kt):
Unreal Engine silently ignores misplaced configuration variables. The patcher enforces canonical section headers:

• r. variables → [/Script/Engine.RendererSettings]
• r.SupportAllShaderPermutations & dp. commands → also accepted by [/Script/Engine.RendererOverrideSettings]
• s. variables → [/Script/Engine.StreamingSettings]
• gc. variables → [/Script/Engine.GarbageCollectionSettings]
• n.VerifyPeer, p.EnableMultiplayerWorldOriginRebasing, NetworkEmulationProfiles → [/Script/Engine.NetworkSettings]
• cook. variables → [/Script/UnrealEd.CookerSettings]
• Universal containers: [SystemSettings] and [ConsoleVariables] accept ANY variable type.

Guard Mechanics:
1. Misplaced lines and illegal CVars= / +CVars= / .CVars= prefixes in Engine.ini are highlighted in bold Vibrant Red (#FF2222).
2. Tapping Save presents Auto-Fix Sections, which strips invalid prefixes and moves variables into their correct canonical headers.
3. [Core.Paths], [Core.System], and [/Script/Engine.RendererOverrideSettings] are whitelisted and never moved or modified.
4. DeviceProfiles.ini entries are automatically converted to CVars=Key=Value without disturbing metadata pointers (BaseProfileName, DeviceScore, DeviceType, HardwareLevel).

title: Force Enable C# Environment
keywords: what is c# environment in wuwa

response.text:
Kuro C# Scripting Runtime (Tab 2: Misc Patch):
Kuro Games built an experimental C# scripting runtime for Wuthering Waves that reduces CPU overhead, optimizes asset streaming, and improves frame pacing on supported mobile devices.

Activation Workflow:
1. Open Editor Tab > Misc Patch subtab.
2. Check -ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment (optionally enable -SkipSplash) and tap Patch. This injects flags directly into .../files/UE4Game/Client/UE4CommandLine.txt.
3. Verification: Launch the game. An asterisk (*) at the end of the client version string on the splash screen confirms C# is active. You can also search for Sharphereal entries in Utilities > Decrypted Log Explorer.

⚠️ Hardware Warning: 8 GB physical RAM is the strict minimum requirement. Devices with 4 GB or 6 GB RAM will experience heavy memory pressure and spontaneous force-closing during intensive combat or fast teleportation.

Reverting: Return to Misc Patch, uncheck -ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment, and tap Patch (or tap Revert to Vanilla in Utilities).

title: Elevated Access Hierarchy & Shizuku Setup
keywords: shizuku setup guide step by step

response.text:
Elevated Access Backends Hierarchy (Target SDK 36 • Android 11–15+):
Because Android strictly enforces Scoped Storage on /Android/data/, the patcher detects elevated providers in this order:
• SHIZUKU (Green #47D764): Wireless Debugging / ADB IPC via rikka.shizuku.api (ShizukuManager.kt) — 100% rootless.
• ROOT (Red #E35D6A): Native SU shell execution via topjohnwu libsu Core 6.0.0.
• AXMANAGER (Blue #2AA37D): Axeron shell provider integration (AxManagerManager.kt).
• SHIZUKU_UNAUTHORIZED (Orange #F7C948): Shizuku service running, permission prompt pending approval.
• NONE (Gray #A8B4AF): No provider active. Prompts the setup wizard or falls back to Manual Mode.

Setting Up Shizuku:
1. Install Shizuku from Google Play or GitHub.
2. Connect to Wi-Fi (or a Portable Wi-Fi Hotspot).
3. Enable Developer Options (tap Build Number 7 times).
4. Enable both USB Debugging and Wireless Debugging.
5. In Shizuku, tap Pairing > Developer Options > Pair device with pairing code and enter the 6-digit code.
6. Return to Shizuku, tap Start, then launch WuWa Config Patcher and grant permission.

⚠️ Xiaomi / HyperOS / MIUI Fix: You must enable "USB Debugging (Security Settings)" inside Developer Options (requires a signed-in Mi Account), otherwise Xiaomi will silently block file writes!

title: CVar Analyzer Diagnostics
keywords: cross reference client log with ini

response.text:
Analyze Config (CVarAnalyzer.kt — Tab 3: Advanced Subtab):
Cross-references on-device INI settings against decrypted Client.log execution blocks, checking the latest execution instance near the end of the log to verify whether Kuro's engine accepted your changes.

Analysis Report (ConfigAnalysisDialog.kt):

Status Code Definitions:

UI Controls:

CVar Bank & Reference Library (Tab 3: Advanced Subtab):
A searchable library of 1000+ verified CVars loaded asynchronously via loadAlteriaXAssetsIfNeeded() on a background thread (Dispatchers.IO) from assets/alteriax_cvars.txt (AlteriaX Pastebin) and official Unreal Engine documentation.

Key Features:

Duplicate Flagger (DuplicateCvarFlagger.kt — Tab 3: Advanced > INI Integrity & Cleanup):
Scans active INI configurations for duplicate CVar keys across lines and sections. Duplicate keys confuse the engine parser and can cause inconsistent values to apply in-game.

• Metadata Protection: Automatically protects device metadata pointers (BaseProfileName, DeviceScore, DeviceType, HardwareLevel) from being flagged.
• 1-Tap Cleanup: Displays results in DuplicateFlaggerDialog.kt with a 1-tap resolution workflow to remove conflicting entries safely.

These CVars cause engine rejections, black screens, or game force-closes when applied on mobile devices. Use Strip Forbidden (ForbiddenCvarStripper.kt) in Utilities > Advanced to auto-strip them with 1 tap via ForbiddenCvarDialog.kt!

title: Recommended CVars & Optimization
keywords: good cvars to add engine ini

response.text:
Popular & Recommended CVars for Wuthering Waves:
• r.MobileContentScaleFactor = 0.8 to 1.2 (Section: [SystemSettings] — scales 3D internal render resolution; lower for FPS gains, raise for visual sharpness).
• r.ShadowQuality = 0 to 2 (Section: [SystemSettings] — shadow cascade map resolution).
• r.BloomQuality = 0 or 1 (Section: [SystemSettings] — post-processing glare and bloom).
• r.VSync = 0 (Section: [SystemSettings] — disables VSync to reduce input lag).
• r.VolumetricFog = 0 (Section: [/Script/Engine.RendererSettings] — disables heavy volumetric fog).
• s.AsyncLoadingThreadEnabled = 1 (Section: [/Script/Engine.StreamingSettings] — background asset loading thread).

⚠️ Important: Never inject variables present on the Forbidden CVars list, and always tap Auto-Fix Sections when saving in Smart Mode.

title: Hardware & RAM Requirements
keywords: how much ram do i need for wuwa
low end vs high end hardware

response.text:
Hardware & RAM Recommendations (by Physical RAM Tier):
• 16 GB or higher: High-End Tier. Comfortably handles EXTREME and HIGH_VISUAL presets with abundant memory headroom.
• 12 GB: Recommended Standard. Smooth experience across STABLE, PERFORMANCE, and visual presets with C# enabled.
• 8 GB: Minimum Sweet Spot. Strict minimum requirement for C# Scripting (-ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment). Below 8 GB, C# risks combat force-closes.
• 6 GB: Entry Level. Recommended for STABLE or PERFORMANCE presets. ⚠️ Keep C# disabled to prevent out-of-memory crashes.
• 4 GB: Under-spec. Severe stuttering and force-closes are common. Use clean vanilla defaults or minimal presets.

Check Device Diagnostics:
Go to Utilities > Common > Get Device Info (DeviceStatsCollector.kt) to inspect your exact GPU renderer, Vulkan driver version, physical RAM, CPU cores, and game-evaluated Device Score.

title: DeviceProfiles.ini vs Engine.ini Architecture
keywords: difference between engine ini and deviceprofiles ini

response.text:
DeviceProfiles.ini vs. Engine.ini Architectural Differences:

• Engine.ini: Global engine configuration. Requires standard Key=Value lines grouped strictly under canonical section headers (e.g. [/Script/Engine.RendererSettings]). Using CVars= prefixes here is invalid and triggers Section Guard red highlights.
• DeviceProfiles.ini: Hardware-specific profile overrides. All configuration commands under device blocks (such as [Android_Low] or [Android_PocoX6Pro]) MUST use the CVars=Key=Value format (e.g., CVars=r.ShadowQuality=1).

Metadata Pointers:
In DeviceProfiles.ini, metadata keys like BaseProfileName, DeviceScore, DeviceType, and HardwareLevel must never have CVars= prepended to them and must not be deleted. The patcher's DuplicateCvarFlagger.kt and CVarSectionGuard.kt automatically preserve these pointers.

Custom Repositories & Preset Hosting (Tab 1: ConfigScreen):
WuWa Config Patcher supports loading presets from external web servers or local storage:

1. Custom Online Repository: Direct HTTP/HTTPS link pointing to a remote ZIP file containing preset directories and a valid custom-metadata.txt.
2. Local Repository: Select any local storage directory using Android SAF (OpenDocumentTree()).

Metadata Structure (custom-metadata.txt):
Format directory tags as Folder_Name: CATEGORY | Display Title | Short Description.
Valid categories recognized by PresetCategorization.kt: STABLE, PERFORMANCE, HIGH_VISUAL, COMMUNITY, and OTHER.

• Archives are unpacked into context.cacheDir/repo_cache/ via ZipExtractor.kt.
• Deeply nested configurations are indexed recursively using folder.walkTopDown() in ConfigScanner.kt.

title: Log Decryptor Schemes & Log Explorer
keywords: log decryptor scheme a scheme b

response.text:
Log Decryptor & Real-Time Explorer (Tab 3: Common Subtab):
Kuro Games obfuscates runtime execution logs. LogDecryptor.kt resolves log obfuscation automatically:

• Scheme A (XOR 0xA5 / 0xEF): Used on modern game updates with interleaved key bytes.
• Scheme B (XOR 0x55): Legacy XOR cipher variant used in earlier releases.
• Plaintext Fallback: Directly parses unencrypted development or emulator logs.

Decrypted Log Explorer:
Read real-time logs with exact line numbering and quick-filter chips:
• LogConfig — Configuration file parsing and override events.
• Sharphereal — C# runtime mono execution and script initialization.
• Vulkan / RHI — GPU pipeline, PSO creation, and driver events.
• GameThread / LogTemp — Engine warnings and thread performance drops.

CVar Extractor & Main Storage Reader (Tab 3: Advanced Subtab):
• Extract Log CVars (CVarExtractor.kt): Parses decrypted Client.log line-by-line and categorizes each variable with change-frequency remarks:
- Static: Constant variables initialized once at startup.
- Var 1 / Var 2 / Var 3: Variables updated during scene loading, map streaming, or UI changes.
- Hyper: High-frequency variables modified frame-by-frame at runtime.
Results open in CVarExtractorDialog.kt with instant CSV and TXT export options.

• Main Storage Reader (MainStorageReaderDialog.kt): Inspects configuration snapshots stored in context.filesDir/app_main_storage/backups/. Review, copy, share, or use 1-tap Restore Backup to revert your INIs instantly.

title: Remediation: Game Crashing, Lag, Stutter, or Black Screen
keywords: fix game stutter and lag drops
stuck on loading splash screen wuwa

response.text:
Game Crash, Black Screen & Stutter Remediation Sequence:
Follow these steps in order to resolve crashes:

1. Revert to Clean Vanilla Defaults: Go to Utilities > Common > Vanilla mode and tap Revert to Vanilla. This deletes modified Engine.ini, DeviceProfiles.ini, and Scalability.ini so clean factory defaults regenerate on launch.
2. Delete Corrupted Shader Caches: Go to Settings > Danger Zone > Delete Shaders (DeleteShadersDialog.kt) and wipe both Vulkan and OpenGL caches.
3. Strip Forbidden CVars: Go to Utilities > Advanced > Strip Forbidden (ForbiddenCvarStripper.kt) and tap Auto Strip All.
4. Check C# Environment & RAM: If your device has less than 8 GB RAM, open Editor > Misc Patch and uncheck -ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment.
5. Send Diagnostics: If crashing persists, tap Support > Report a Bug (BugReportDialog.kt) to send your device specs and activity_log.txt to Arglax.

title: Remediation: Shizuku Not Working or Access NONE

response.text:
Troubleshooting Elevated Access 'NONE' & Shizuku Failures:

1. Check Shizuku Service Status: Open the Shizuku app. Ensure it says "Shizuku is running". If stopped, re-pair via Wireless Debugging with the 6-digit code.
2. Xiaomi / HyperOS / MIUI Mandatory Setting: In Developer Options, enable "USB Debugging (Security Settings)" (requires Mi Account login). Without this, Xiaomi blocks Shizuku from executing file writes.
3. Refresh App Permissions: Open WuWa Config Patcher, go to Settings > Application Info, and tap Refresh. If still failing, revoke permission in Shizuku, force-stop the patcher, and reopen it.
4. Root Fallback: If your device is rooted, tap Grant Root in Settings to use native SU via libsu.
5. Report Backend Issue: If elevation fails repeatedly, open Support > Report a Bug to send your IPC log.

title: Remediation: Vibrant Red CVars & Failed Section Checks
keywords: how to fix red cvars in editor
prefix error cvars= in engine ini

response.text:
Resolving Red Text (#FF2222) & Section Guard Flags:

1. 1-Tap Auto-Fix Sections: When saving in Config Editor, select Auto-Fix Sections. The patcher strips invalid CVars= prefixes from Engine.ini and places variables into canonical headers (RendererSettings, StreamingSettings, NetworkSettings, etc.).
2. Inspect CVar Analyzer: Launch the game, then open Utilities > Advanced > Analyze Config. If a variable is marked DELETED BY GAME, Kuro's runtime explicitly stripped it because it is unsupported or on the Forbidden CVars blacklist.
3. Whitelisted Section Headers: [Core.Paths], [Core.System], and [/Script/Engine.RendererOverrideSettings] are whitelisted and never altered.

title: Thermal, Battery & Frame Pacing Tuning
keywords: how to stop phone heating wuwa
how to eliminate stuttering in combat

response.text:
Thermal, Battery & Frame Pacing Optimization:

• Resolution Scaling (r.MobileContentScaleFactor): The single biggest factor in GPU thermal throttling. Set to 0.85 or 0.9 for sustained 60 FPS without aggressive heating, or 1.0+ only if using external cooling.
• Background Asset Streaming (s.AsyncLoadingThreadEnabled=1): Shifts texture decompression to background threads, minimizing hitching when rotating the camera in dense cities.
• C# Scripting Runtime: If your phone has 8 GB+ RAM, check -ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment in Tab 2: Misc Patch to reduce CPU overhead during combat scenes.
• Clean Shader Compiles: Wipe shader caches via Settings > Danger Zone > Delete Shaders after every major game version update.
